Logical Model: Logical model for remote monitoring context in the scope of the VUNS project

Official URL: http://si-s-serv1041.st.chulg/ig/VersUnSouffleNouveauIG/StructureDefinition/vuns-context Version: 0.1.2
Draft as of 2025-08-04 Computable Name: VunsContext

This models represents the information extracted from the EHR to contextualize a remote monitoring session in the scope of the VUNS project.

Usage:

  • This Logical Model Profile is not used by any profiles in this Implementation Guide

Constraints

IdGradePath(s)DétailsRequirements
con-1errorvuns-context.diagnostic.stageStage SHALL have summary or assessment
: summary.exists() or assessment.exists()
con-2errorvuns-context.diagnostic.evidenceevidence SHALL have code or details
: code.exists() or detail.exists()
con-3best practicevuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL be present if verificationStatus is not entered-in-error and category is problem-list-item
: clinicalStatus.exists() or verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code = 'entered-in-error').exists() or category.select($this='problem-list-item').empty()
con-4errorvuns-context.diagnosticIf condition is abated, then clinicalStatus must be either inactive, resolved, or remission
: abatement.empty() or clinicalStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical' and (code='resolved' or code='remission' or code='inactive')).exists()
con-5errorvuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL NOT be present if verification Status is entered-in-error
: verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code='entered-in-error').empty() or clinicalStatus.empty()
dom-2errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources
: contained.contained.empty()
dom-3errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource
: contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated
: contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label
: contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6best practicevuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsA resource should have narrative for robust management
: text.`div`.exists()
ele-1error**ALL** elementsAll FHIR elements must have a @value or children
: hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1error**ALL** extensionsMust have either extensions or value[x], not both
: extension.exists() != value.exists()
pat-1errorvuns-context.patient.contactSHALL at least contain a contact's details or a reference to an organization
: name.exists() or telecom.exists() or address.exists() or organization.exists()

identifier 1..1 string L'identifiant du patient dans les systèmes CHUL. Cet identifiant est encrypté avec la clé publique de l'hôpital lorsqu'il est envoyé à l'extérieur.
firstName 1..1 string Prénom du patient tel qu'enregistré dans les systèmes CHUL
lastName 1..1 string Nom de famille du patient tel qu'enregistré dans les systèmes CHUL
birthDate 1..1 date Date de naissance du patient
gender 1..1 code Sexe du patient.
phoneNumber 1..* string Le ou les numéros de téélhone du patient.
email 1..1 string L'adresse email du patient
diagnostic 1..* VunsPneumoCondition Le/les diagnostics principaux du patient dans le cadre du programme de télésurveillance
code 1..1 CodeableConcept Le code du diagnostic principal
vitalSigns 0..* Element Les paramètres vitaux de référence du patient
weight 0..1 Quantity Le poids du patient
height 0..1 Quantity La taille du patient
significantResults 0..* VunsPneumoBioReport Les résultats significatifs des analyses biologiques du patient
hemoglobin 0..1 Quantity Hémoglobine
CRP 0..1 Quantity CRP
eosinophils 0..1 Quantity Éosinophiles
creatinin 0..1 Quantity Créatinine
glomerularFiltrationRate 0..1 Quantity Taux de filtration glomérulaire
tobaccoUse 0..1 Element Le statut tabagique du patient
tobaccoUseStatus 0..1 code Le statut tabagique du patient
tobaccoUseQuantity 0..1 integer Nombre de cigarettes fumées par jour
tobaccoUseAge 0..1 integer Nombre d'années de tabagisme

Constraints

IdGradePath(s)DétailsRequirements
con-1errorvuns-context.diagnostic.stageStage SHALL have summary or assessment
: summary.exists() or assessment.exists()
con-2errorvuns-context.diagnostic.evidenceevidence SHALL have code or details
: code.exists() or detail.exists()
con-3best practicevuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL be present if verificationStatus is not entered-in-error and category is problem-list-item
: clinicalStatus.exists() or verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code = 'entered-in-error').exists() or category.select($this='problem-list-item').empty()
con-4errorvuns-context.diagnosticIf condition is abated, then clinicalStatus must be either inactive, resolved, or remission
: abatement.empty() or clinicalStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical' and (code='resolved' or code='remission' or code='inactive')).exists()
con-5errorvuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL NOT be present if verification Status is entered-in-error
: verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code='entered-in-error').empty() or clinicalStatus.empty()
dom-2errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources
: contained.contained.empty()
dom-3errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource
: contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated
: contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label
: contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6best practicevuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsA resource should have narrative for robust management
: text.`div`.exists()
ele-1error**ALL** elementsAll FHIR elements must have a @value or children
: hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1error**ALL** extensionsMust have either extensions or value[x], not both
: extension.exists() != value.exists()
pat-1errorvuns-context.patient.contactSHALL at least contain a contact's details or a reference to an organization
: name.exists() or telecom.exists() or address.exists() or organization.exists()

Constraints

IdGradePath(s)DétailsRequirements
con-1errorvuns-context.diagnostic.stageStage SHALL have summary or assessment
: summary.exists() or assessment.exists()
con-2errorvuns-context.diagnostic.evidenceevidence SHALL have code or details
: code.exists() or detail.exists()
con-3best practicevuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL be present if verificationStatus is not entered-in-error and category is problem-list-item
: clinicalStatus.exists() or verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code = 'entered-in-error').exists() or category.select($this='problem-list-item').empty()
con-4errorvuns-context.diagnosticIf condition is abated, then clinicalStatus must be either inactive, resolved, or remission
: abatement.empty() or clinicalStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical' and (code='resolved' or code='remission' or code='inactive')).exists()
con-5errorvuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL NOT be present if verification Status is entered-in-error
: verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code='entered-in-error').empty() or clinicalStatus.empty()
dom-2errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources
: contained.contained.empty()
dom-3errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource
: contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated
: contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label
: contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6best practicevuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsA resource should have narrative for robust management
: text.`div`.exists()
ele-1error**ALL** elementsAll FHIR elements must have a @value or children
: hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1error**ALL** extensionsMust have either extensions or value[x], not both
: extension.exists() != value.exists()
pat-1errorvuns-context.patient.contactSHALL at least contain a contact's details or a reference to an organization
: name.exists() or telecom.exists() or address.exists() or organization.exists()

Constraints

IdGradePath(s)DétailsRequirements
con-1errorvuns-context.diagnostic.stageStage SHALL have summary or assessment
: summary.exists() or assessment.exists()
con-2errorvuns-context.diagnostic.evidenceevidence SHALL have code or details
: code.exists() or detail.exists()
con-3best practicevuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL be present if verificationStatus is not entered-in-error and category is problem-list-item
: clinicalStatus.exists() or verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code = 'entered-in-error').exists() or category.select($this='problem-list-item').empty()
con-4errorvuns-context.diagnosticIf condition is abated, then clinicalStatus must be either inactive, resolved, or remission
: abatement.empty() or clinicalStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-clinical' and (code='resolved' or code='remission' or code='inactive')).exists()
con-5errorvuns-context.diagnosticCondition.clinicalStatus SHALL NOT be present if verification Status is entered-in-error
: verificationStatus.coding.where(system='http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status' and code='entered-in-error').empty() or clinicalStatus.empty()
dom-2errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT contain nested Resources
: contained.contained.empty()
dom-3errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource
: contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()
dom-4errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a meta.versionId or a meta.lastUpdated
: contained.meta.versionId.empty() and contained.meta.lastUpdated.empty()
dom-5errorvuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsIf a resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL NOT have a security label
: contained.meta.security.empty()
dom-6best practicevuns-context.patient, vuns-context.diagnostic, vuns-context.significantResultsA resource should have narrative for robust management
: text.`div`.exists()
ele-1error**ALL** elementsAll FHIR elements must have a @value or children
: hasValue() or (children().count() > id.count())
ext-1error**ALL** extensionsMust have either extensions or value[x], not both
: extension.exists() != value.exists()
pat-1errorvuns-context.patient.contactSHALL at least contain a contact's details or a reference to an organization
: name.exists() or telecom.exists() or address.exists() or organization.exists()
